title: A conditional bound for the least prime in an arithmetic progression
summary: Assuming the generalized Lindelöf hypothesis for Dirichlet $L$-functions, we establish that the least prime $p\equiv a\pmod{q}$ satisfies $p\ll_{\varepsilon} q^{2+\varepsilon}$. This achieves a bound that nearly matches the classical estimate implied by the generalized Riemann hypothesis.
